title: [finding] The governed-PR review-request notification channel fails for PRs authored by the os-zhuang seat — "Review cannot be requested from pull request author"
body:
Measured by the skills seat (session `session_01MsbKEG4LtERSLaDrbehM3e`, 2026-08-22) on the first governed PR of its batch. Filed as `finding` under the skills-lane self-triage exception; grading next round.

## Measured

The ACCEPT path for a governed-surface PR requires requesting review from `os-zhuang` (the maintainer's notification account — draft-PR review requests push to their phone; ruling 2026-08-19). On PR #11077, authored by a dev dispatched from an `os-zhuang` seat session, the call fails hard:

```
update_pull_request(reviewers: ["os-zhuang"]) → 422
"Review cannot be requested from pull request author."
```

GitHub forbids requesting review from a PR's author. Seats run as several accounts (os-elon, os-warren, huangyiirene, os-sales, os-zhuang…) — so the channel works for most lanes but structurally fails for every governed PR authored under `os-zhuang`, which includes any seat the maintainer runs interactively under their own account.

## Impact

The "awaiting a human merge" push notification never fires for exactly this class; the PR is visible only via the round report and the assignee fallback (assigning the PR to `os-zhuang` does work and was applied to #11077 as the interim).

## Directions (grading input)

1. Record the assignee fallback as the standing alternative in the ACCEPT-path clause: request review where possible; on the author-identity failure, assign the PR to the maintainer's account instead, and say so in the round report. (Cheapest; protocol text, ratchet-paid.)
2. Route os-zhuang-seat governed dispatches to a different authoring identity so the review-request channel always works. (Fleet-shape change — maintainer territory.)

Refs: the ACCEPT 路径分叉 clause in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` · PR #11077 (where measured).
